raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Summary Add `register_prefetch_chain(name, weights)` so model integrations can assign already GTP-sharded weights to independent prefetch chains without relying on parameter-name conventions. - Preserve default classification for unregistered weights. - Keep each grouped projection’s local-expert weights together. - Preserve warmup-discovered ordering, CUDA-graph boundaries and shared communication streams. - Isolate gathered-buffer ownership across independent chains. - Reject conflicting assignments and registration after initialization; allow empty optional selections. Registration controls scheduling membership—not which parameters are sharded. ## Validation - Black, isort, pylint and Ruff passed. - 121 targeted tests passed per rank on four GB300 GPUs, covering registration, numerical correctness, BF16/MXFP8 graph replay and recomputation. - The attention-only partial-graph failure also reproduces on untouched upstream main. - Broader GTP unit-test coverage is in progress.

Follow-up review of changes since the prior clean review at `0201ccf0eb96d86e3b5439c00cd17031542a4053`, covering automatic default registration, affected runtime scheduling, tests, and documentation. Found one initialization regression below and one documentation mismatch.

### Update the documented default grouped-chain IDs

The [grouped-expert Design paragraph](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/docs/api-guide/core/generalized_tensor_parallel.md#L777) still presents `GTP_remat_grouped_fc1_{graphed,ungraphed}` and `GTP_remat_grouped_fc2_{graphed,ungraphed}` as the runtime chain IDs. These matched the [previous initialization path](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0201ccf0eb96d86e3b5439c00cd17031542a4053/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L701-L721). With the new [automatic registration](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L701-L740), ordinary MoE initialization instead produces `GTP_registered_default_expert_fc1_ungraphed` and `GTP_registered_default_expert_fc2_ungraphed`, or their `_graphed` counterparts. Readers inspecting the logged chains will not find the documented defaults.

Replace that paragraph's parenthetical examples with:

```text
(`GTP_registered_default_expert_fc1_{graphed,ungraphed}` /
`GTP_registered_default_expert_fc2_{graphed,ungraphed}` under standard initialization;
explicit registrations or default-name collisions can change the logical-name component)
```

Preserve the explanation that FC1/FC2 are separate, same-role chains across consecutive blocks and share communication streams. The old IDs remain valid for the low-level unregistered classifier; do not describe them as universally invalid.

**Proposed acceptance checks, not executed:** trace a standard-name grouped FC1/FC2 pair through `classify_gtp_remat_chains` in eager and full-iteration modes and confirm the documented IDs match the resolver. Retain the [registration assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L123-L136) that FC1/FC2 have distinct chain IDs but the same stream key. This replacement is source-reasoned and requires author verification.

Static inspection only; tests were not executed. The linked PDF's compressed visual content could not be assessed with the text-only tools.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex. This was a findings-only review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

**Preserve the existing chain-free opt-out during default registration.** Before classification, set `prefetch_initialized = True` and `_need_weight_prefetch = False` on a fresh eager dense GTP weight, then call `classify_gtp_remat_chains`. This is the [documented synchronous fallback](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/docs/api-guide/core/generalized_tensor_parallel.md#L714). The [previous entrypoint](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0201ccf0eb96d86e3b5439c00cd17031542a4053/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L701-L721) accepted it: its eager classification matched the initial `GTP_ungraphed` identity, and warmup skipped linking. The new default-registration pass includes it and raises `RuntimeError` at the [late-registration guard](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L207-L212), preventing model setup.

In `_register_default_prefetch_chains`, skip these already opted-out weights when collecting defaults:

```suggestion
        if hasattr(weight, "_gtp_prefetch_chain_name") or weight.prefetch_initialized:
```

Keep the public `register_prefetch_chain` late-registration rejection unchanged. The invariant is that automatic defaults must not convert an existing chain-free opt-out into a registration request. Fresh dense weights must still register; explicit overrides must remain untouched; fresh grouped projections must still register all local-expert members together.

**Proposed regression check, not executed:** using `_weight` and `_model` from the [registration tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L26-L35), create two dense weights, set both opt-out flags on the first, and classify with CUDA graphs disabled. Expect no exception, no `_gtp_prefetch_chain_name` on the first, its chain ID still `GTP_ungraphed`, and `default_dense` membership on the fresh peer. Inspect that the [warmup linking guard](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L2084-L2092) still excludes the opted-out weight. Retain the existing [late-registration rejection](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L66-L73) and [initialization assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L233-L243): custom membership survives, replicated weights stay unregistered, Mamba projections share a dense chain, and FC1/FC2 each retain their complete projection. The suggested replacement is source-reasoned; verify it before adopting.

@@ -732,6 +732,44 @@ A weight can be kept **out** of a chain by setting `weight.prefetch_initialized
 
 **Rule of thumb:** any change that creates/replaces params at runtime, makes forward order data-dependent, runs GTP_remat concurrently, or builds multiple GTP models per process must be checked against the table above. When in doubt, exclude the affected weights so they fall back to synchronous, chain-free all-gather.
 
+#### Explicit chain registration
+
+**One API selects which GTP-sharded weights prefetch one another:**
+`register_prefetch_chain(name, weights)`. See the
+[registration overview (PDF)](figures/gtp_prefetch_chain_api.pdf).
+
+**Production defaults require no user calls.** After DDP wrapping,
+`classify_gtp_remat_chains` registers dense, grouped-expert FC1, and grouped-expert FC2
+chains per process group, preserving explicit overrides and skipping replicated weights.
+Both Mamba projections stay in the dense chain.
+
+For a custom chain, register after parameter wrapping and before classification/warmup:
+
+```python
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.gtp_api import (
+    classify_gtp_remat_chains,
+    is_gtp_param,
+    register_prefetch_chain,
+)
+
+# attention_candidates is supplied by the model integration; skip unsharded weights.
+register_prefetch_chain("attention", [w for w in attention_candidates if is_gtp_param(w)])
+classify_gtp_remat_chains(model, cuda_graph_impl="full_iteration")
+```
+
+- **Membership and order:** warmup learns execution links; registration order does not
+  set prefetch order. Recompute-forward can visit a subset in a different order, within
+  the same registered chain boundaries.
+- **Grouped experts:** pass `weight0` to include the entire local-expert projection.
+  Coalescing is preserved. Empty selections are valid; conflicting assignments,
+  replicated weights, mixed dense/grouped weights, and mixed process groups are rejected.
+- **Runtime mapping:** classification splits captured/eager scopes. Chains can share
+  communication streams but maintain separate temporary weight buffers; more chains
+  can increase memory use.
+
+Use the same registration on every participating rank. The API requires existing
+GTP operator integration; it does not enable sharding or add support to new operators.
+
 #### Grouped-expert chains (one-block-ahead)
 
 *Problem.* A chain gives every all-gather exactly **one consume-step of runway** — layer *i*'s AG hides behind layer *i−1*'s GEMM — which suffices only while the transfer stays inside the NVLink domain. Routed-expert weights fail that test twice over: by **volume**, a block gathers `2 × num_experts / EP` expert weights — NCCL-coalesced into just **two** all-gathers, one for FC1 and one for FC2 — so those two transfers carry most of the block's bytes; by **distance**, `EGTP_remat` is the group that leaves the NVLink domain. The expert transfer therefore stays partly exposed in **every** MoE block, and the exposure grows as expert count rises and per-GEMM time falls.

+def register_prefetch_chain(name: str, weights: Iterable[torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+    """Assign GTP-sharded weights to a named prefetch chain before runtime initialization.
+
+    Call after GTP wrapping (and any parameter-replacing wrappers), before
+    ``classify_gtp_remat_chains`` and the first forward. Registration selects membership,
+    not execution order: warmup discovers forward/backward and recompute links. It does
+    not enable sharding, change collective grouping, or allocate a communication stream.
+    Model initialization registers default chains for weights without an override.
+
+    Args:
+        name: Logical chain name, containing letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens.
+        weights: GTP-sharded weights. For a grouped projection, pass its leading weight
+            (``weight0``); all local-expert weights in its existing ``weight_list`` are
+            assigned together. Passing the complete group is also supported. An empty
+            selection is a no-op, e.g. when an optional sharding policy is disabled.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: Invalid name, conflicting membership, mixed dense/grouped weights,
+            different process groups, or an incomplete grouped projection.
+        TypeError: A supplied weight is not GTP-sharded.
+        RuntimeError: Classification or warmup has already started for a selected weight.
+
+    All ranks must register the same logical schedule. Registered chains inherit the
+    existing CUDA-graph scope classification and are split at captured/eager boundaries.
+    Dense chains share the default dense streams; grouped chains share the expert streams,
+    each still keyed by process group and capture state. Registration is not a new
+    operator integration: consumers must already implement the DistributedWeight protocol.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", name):
+        raise ValueError("Prefetch chain name must contain only letters, digits, '_', '.' or '-'")
+    selected = {}
+    for weight in weights:
+        if not is_gtp_param(weight):
+            raise TypeError("Prefetch chains accept only already GTP-sharded weights")
+        selected[id(weight)] = weight
+    # A grouped projection is one consumer. Never split its local-expert collective.
+    for weight in tuple(selected.values()):
+        if weight.weight_list is not None:
+            for member in weight.weight_list:
+                selected[id(member)] = member
+    leaders = {
+        id(member)
+        for weight in selected.values()
+        if weight.weight_list is not None
+        for member in weight.weight_list

+    kinds = set()
+    groups = set()
+    for weight in selected.values():
+        if weight.is_routed_expert and id(weight) not in leaders:
+            raise ValueError("Register a grouped projection through its leading weight (weight0)")

+            getattr(weight, "_gtp_chain_classified", False)
+            or weight.prefetch_initialized
+            or weight._recompute_initialized
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("Register prefetch chains before classification and warmup")
+        previous = getattr(weight, "_gtp_prefetch_chain_name", name)
+        if previous != name:
+            raise ValueError(f"Weight already belongs to prefetch chain {previous!r}")
+        kinds.add(weight.is_routed_expert)
+        groups.add(id(weight.group))
+    if len(kinds) > 1 or len(groups) > 1:
+        raise ValueError("A prefetch chain must have one weight kind and one process group")
+    # Validate the entire request before mutating parameters.
+    for weight in selected.values():
+        weight._gtp_prefetch_chain_name = name
+

+    """Resolve explicit membership while retaining the default capture boundary."""
+    name = getattr(param, "_gtp_prefetch_chain_name", None)

**Preserve the existing chain-free opt-out during default registration.** Before classification, set `prefetch_initialized = True` and `_need_weight_prefetch = False` on a fresh eager dense GTP weight, then call `classify_gtp_remat_chains`. This is the [documented synchronous fallback](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/docs/api-guide/core/generalized_tensor_parallel.md#L714). The [previous entrypoint](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0201ccf0eb96d86e3b5439c00cd17031542a4053/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L701-L721) accepted it: its eager classification matched the initial `GTP_ungraphed` identity, and warmup skipped linking. The new default-registration pass includes it and raises `RuntimeError` at the [late-registration guard](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L207-L212), preventing model setup.

In `_register_default_prefetch_chains`, skip these already opted-out weights when collecting defaults:

```suggestion
        if hasattr(weight, "_gtp_prefetch_chain_name") or weight.prefetch_initialized:
```

Keep the public `register_prefetch_chain` late-registration rejection unchanged. The invariant is that automatic defaults must not convert an existing chain-free opt-out into a registration request. Fresh dense weights must still register; explicit overrides must remain untouched; fresh grouped projections must still register all local-expert members together.

**Proposed regression check, not executed:** using `_weight` and `_model` from the [registration tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L26-L35), create two dense weights, set both opt-out flags on the first, and classify with CUDA graphs disabled. Expect no exception, no `_gtp_prefetch_chain_name` on the first, its chain ID still `GTP_ungraphed`, and `default_dense` membership on the fresh peer. Inspect that the [warmup linking guard](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L2084-L2092) still excludes the opted-out weight. Retain the existing [late-registration rejection](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L66-L73) and [initialization assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L233-L243): custom membership survives, replicated weights stay unregistered, Mamba projections share a dense chain, and FC1/FC2 each retain their complete projection. The suggested replacement is source-reasoned; verify it before adopting.

Follow-up review of changes since the prior clean review at `0201ccf0eb96d86e3b5439c00cd17031542a4053`, covering automatic default registration, affected runtime scheduling, tests, and documentation. Found one initialization regression below and one documentation mismatch.

### Update the documented default grouped-chain IDs

The [grouped-expert Design paragraph](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/docs/api-guide/core/generalized_tensor_parallel.md#L777) still presents `GTP_remat_grouped_fc1_{graphed,ungraphed}` and `GTP_remat_grouped_fc2_{graphed,ungraphed}` as the runtime chain IDs. These matched the [previous initialization path](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0201ccf0eb96d86e3b5439c00cd17031542a4053/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L701-L721). With the new [automatic registration](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/megatron/core/tensor_parallel/generalized_tensor_parallelism.py#L701-L740), ordinary MoE initialization instead produces `GTP_registered_default_expert_fc1_ungraphed` and `GTP_registered_default_expert_fc2_ungraphed`, or their `_graphed` counterparts. Readers inspecting the logged chains will not find the documented defaults.

Replace that paragraph's parenthetical examples with:

```text
(`GTP_registered_default_expert_fc1_{graphed,ungraphed}` /
`GTP_registered_default_expert_fc2_{graphed,ungraphed}` under standard initialization;
explicit registrations or default-name collisions can change the logical-name component)
```

Preserve the explanation that FC1/FC2 are separate, same-role chains across consecutive blocks and share communication streams. The old IDs remain valid for the low-level unregistered classifier; do not describe them as universally invalid.

**Proposed acceptance checks, not executed:** trace a standard-name grouped FC1/FC2 pair through `classify_gtp_remat_chains` in eager and full-iteration modes and confirm the documented IDs match the resolver. Retain the [registration assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c9434b4e36273ce604c0a779c27f351c240b6863/tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/test_gtp_prefetch_registration.py#L123-L136) that FC1/FC2 have distinct chain IDs but the same stream key. This replacement is source-reasoned and requires author verification.
